Memories & Moments

Her Beautiful World

A Letter
"You make every ordinary moment feel like it was plucked from a dream."

I have watched you stand with quiet confidence at the Grand Mosque, laugh under Moscow snowflakes, and hold that "24" cake like it was the beginning of everything — because it is.

You carry whole cities inside your eyes. You are the Mona Lisa and the miracle garden and the skyline all at once. And somehow, impossibly, you are mine.

Happy birthday, love. Every year with you is a privilege.
